title: BOXBOX: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement for Long-Running Performance Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.09218v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated harness optimization improves agents by learning from trajectories and task feedback. Existing offline methods use reference answers to optimize harnesses for reuse on held-out tasks. However, many real-world tasks are open-ended, while long runs expose new difficulties that offline-optimized harnesses may not address. To study harness optimization in these settings, we introduce PerfRace, a benchmark for long-running performance optimization of software projects, and investigate whether agents can use task-specific experience to recursively improve their harnesses during an ongoing task. To this end, we introduce BOXBOX, which enables agent-triggered harness revision and kernel-managed hot reloading while preserving execution context. translated_title: BOXBOX：面向长期运行性能优化的递归式智能体框架自我改进
translated_abstract: 自动化的智能体框架优化通过从执行轨迹和任务反馈中学习来改进智能体。现有的离线方法使用参考答案来优化框架，以便在保留任务上复用。然而，许多现实世界的任务是开放式的，而长时间运行会暴露出离线优化的框架可能无法应对的新困难。为了研究这些场景下的框架优化，我们提出了PerfRace，一个针对软件项目长期运行性能优化的基准，并研究智能体能否在正在进行的任务中利用任务特定的经验来递归地改进其框架。为此，我们提出了BOXBOX，它支持由智能体触发的框架修订和内核管理的热重载，同时保留执行上下文。我们在匹配的测试时预算下，将BOXBOX与冻结框架、离线框架演化和框架扩展方法在PerfRace上进行比较。BOXBOX以更高的效率实现了更高的加速。
tldr: BOXBOX让智能体能够在长期运行的任务中递归地自我改进自己的执行框架（通过智能体触发的框架修订与内核管理的热重载机制），并在PerfRace基准上以匹配的测试预算下比冻结框架、离线框架演化和框架扩展方法取得更高的加速比和效率。
en_tdlr: BOXBOX enables agents to recursively self-improve their harness during long-running tasks through agent-triggered harness revision and kernel-managed hot reloading, achieving higher speedup and efficiency than frozen, offline-evolved, or scaled harnesses under matched test-time budgets on the PerfRace benchmark.
